days_meaning: each delivery day costs you this much cash

messages.text: Hello, and thank you for meeting me. I would propose 61 P with delivery on day 10.
I can do 60 P with delivery in 0 days. Every round costs us both, so let's close.

61 P with delivery in 0 days works for me and we can close now.
Thank you. My offer stays at 60 P with delivery on day 10, and I am happy to close there.
